title: A note on tractor bundles and codimension two spacelike immersions
summary: We study conformal tractor bundles from an extrinsic viewpoint, relating them to codimension two spacelike immersions into Lorentzian manifolds. We show that, at least locally, every Riemannian conformal structure admits a natural realization of its normal conformal tractor bundle as the pullback of the tangent bundle of a suitably constructed Lorentzian ambient space.
